effect.reply: I do, with the Office's sand-glass and the Bright One's patience. Every square has a board, and every board gets the hour the tube came through. No wagon ever had its hours written up in public.
Then the wagons get the realm's post, and the Office lets half of us go. I owe a factor money by the new moon. I'd rather run till my pads bleed than lose this place.
Over two days with a load, every time. Over one day with a tube? Ha. I've a wager on the wagon, friend, and a wager's a wager. Run fair and I'll buy the first round at the Grey Gull, win or lose.
Here it is, sealed. Every square's hour, as the tube came through. Straight to the Council Press with it, and the Bright One speed you.

phases.journal: The Couriers' Office has bet its charter on the Long Run: one tube, paw to paw, from the Sound to the Waste in a day.

effects.text: Legs wanted! The Couriers' Office runs the Long Run as soon as we've runners. Ask me for a trial leg.

phases.journal: The Couriers' Office wants runners for the Long Run, the same road the howl will take on the Moot night.

effects.text: Same road the howl will take on the Moot night, they say. Best learn it now. Ask me for a trial leg.

phases.journal: The Long Run is on: the Couriers' tube is on the road from Oakhaven to Saltwell.

effects.text: The tube's on the road! Get to a square and cheer it through, or carry it on if you've the legs.

phases.journal: The Couriers beat the wagons: Sound to Waste in a day, paw to paw.

effects.text: Sound to Waste in a day, paw to paw. Let the Council read that sheet and argue with it.
Fair run. The first round at the Grey Gull is mine, and I'll pay it smiling.
We keep our places! I'll run every leg of it again next season, and gladly.

phases.journal: The Carters' Yard wagon reached Saltwell first. The wagons have the realm's post this season.

effects.text: The wagons have it this season. Next season, then, and faster.
Wagons it is, this season. Run again next season and I'll lose my wager gladly.
Half of us let go, they say. Next season, then. I'll be on the list.
THE LONG RUN: the Carters' Yard wagon reached Saltwell before the tube this season. We run again next season. The Couriers' Office.

quests.title: A Trial Leg
quests.summary: Run the Couriers' tube from the Couriers' Office door to the Oakhaven square and back, against the sand-glass.

offer.ask: Is the Couriers' Office hiring legs?
offer.say: #greet#, #address#. The Carters' Yard swears its wagons beat paws across the realm, and the Council's listening. So the Office has bet its charter on the Long Run: one tube, paw to paw, every square from the Sound to the Waste in a day. Run me a trial leg.
offer.handIn: There and back. How did I do?
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Not bad at all. You're on my list. When we've runners enough we run it for real, on a Marketday at dawn, and the whole realm watches the squares.
